first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing directly addresses competitor-driven SMB losses and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify the source record before committing because sustainable qualified revenue depends on cohort quality, discount durability, margin, and retention—not acquisition lift alone.

final.rationale: Reject promotional pricing because the verified cohort gained qualified revenue short term but suffered 12% lower 30-day retention, conflicting with sustainable long-term revenue. Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and is supported by prior durable lifts in activation, time-to-value, and early adoption. Run a standard experiment with qualified-revenue and retention guardrails rather than assume earlier results will fully replicate.
